name: table-states
title: Table states
description: The four states of a table body, loading, empty, no results after filtering and a failed load with retry, all kept inside the table.
docs: Put TableBodyState where the TableBody would be: it renders its own tbody, so the header stays put from one state to the next. For the columns to hold their widths when the rows arrive too, give the table table-fixed and widths on its header cells (w-28 and so on, one column left automatic): a table that sizes its columns to what is in them re-flows when that changes, and no body can prevent it. Give columnCount the number of columns and rowCount about a page of rows, so loading takes the height the rows will. A message is one cell across all columns; its words reach a screen reader through a status region that exists before the words do. filters names the active filters in the filtered-empty state; onClear and onRetry add the buttons. Retry and Clear filters are removed by the state they cause, so while the body stays mounted it takes the focus they had (it is focusable by script and is not a tab stop). When you swap it for your own rows, move focus yourself, to the table or its first row.
